title: AC1024 associative dependency body edge retention
scope: Retain the explicit dep_body handle already consumed by the ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY DWG parser.
Keep dep_body distinct from the owning handle and the legacy read/write dependency/node fields.
Preserve the new field across reset, copy construction, and assignment.
